arguments.content:
import os, shutil, sys, zipfile

src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

if os.path.exists(dst):
    shutil.rmtree(dst)
os.makedirs(dst)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as z:
    z.extractall(dst)

print("Extracted:", src, "->", dst)
print(sorted(os.listdir(dst)))

import os, re, zipfile

SRC_DIR = "unpacked"
OUT_FILE = "quarterly_report.docx"
TMP_FILE = OUT_FILE + ".tmp"

all_files = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(SRC_DIR):
    for f in files:
        full = os.path.join(root, f)
        rel = os.path.relpath(full, SRC_DIR).replace(os.sep, "/")
        all_files.append((rel, full))

# Write [Content_Types].xml first (OOXML convention)
all_files.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0] != "[Content_Types].xml", x[0]))

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP_FILE, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for rel, full in all_files:
        z.write(full, rel)
os.replace(TMP_FILE, OUT_FILE)

# ---- Verification of the final .docx ----
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT_FILE) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    assert "[Content_Types].xml" in names and "word/document.xml" in names
    xml = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")

u_count = len(re.findall(r"<w:u w:val=\"single\"/>", xml))
print("packed entries:", len(all_files))
print("underline tags in final docx:", u_count)

headlines = ["EXECUTIVE SUMMARY", "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS", "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
             "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS", "OPERATING EXPENSES", "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK", "RISK FACTORS"]
for h in headlines:
    ok = f">EXECUTIVE SUMMARY" if False else f"<w:t xml:space=\"preserve\">{h}</w:t>"
    present = ok in xml
    underlined = f'<w:u w:val="single"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">{h}</w:t>' in xml
    print(f"{h}: present={present} underlined={underlined}")

# Body text must be untouched
assert "total revenue reaching $487.3 million" in xml
assert "• Revenue: $487.3M (↑12.4% YoY)" in xml
print("body content unchanged: OK")
